findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 13 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 64 questions numbered 1-64; by section: 13.1 10, 13.2 5, 13.3 17, 13.4 9, 13.5 6, 13.6 17.

Covers the introduction and sections 13.1-13.6 (with the daily-life, neutron-star and Sun boxes) in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (Brownian motion definition and year 1827, rms = √<v²>, P = ⅓ρ<v²>, P = ⅔N₀<K.E.>, least massive stars live longest, Maxwell spelt Clerk, supernova stage).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
